(2) The woman turns around quickly to face the camera. Her facial expression is initially questioning, with focused eyes and a neutral mouth. She wears black knee-high socks. The background remains consistent, featuring the sleek, industrial aesthetic of a clean public transit station. (3) She breaks into a wide smile and begins a rhythmic dance, waving her right hand in a 'no' gesture before pointing to her temple. Her movements are fluid and energetic. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame, overlaying her lower body.
